heading: About IH Johannesburg
intro: An IH World affiliate in Parktown: Cambridge-certified faculty, the only independent IELTS testing centre in South Africa, and the sole Cambridge ESOL centre in Gauteng.
facilities-list: Two computer labs — internet + self-access material
Library: books, audio readers, magazines, newspapers
Canteen with hot and cold food

t2-role: CELTA trainer — DELTA 2015 — Aviation & Cambridge assessor
t4-role: CELTA-certified — librarian, CELTA admin, social programme
t6-role: At IHJ since 2012 — Honours in Dramatic Art (WITS)
social-text: Last Friday of each course: bowling, Johannesburg Zoo, Gold Reef City, Soweto tour, white water rafting, Montecasino Bird Gardens, cultural luncheons and more.
